scope: Eager backward + tape/gradient release + device synchronize. Includes source dY quantization, planner and output handling. Fresh Forward is completed before timing. Excludes optimizer and one-time FP8 weight preparation. BF16 dW output for every variant.
method: 20 warmups + 50 variable-token/route samples, two runs with reversed variant order; median of 100 per-sample slowest-rank times. All workload hashes, token arrays and received-row arrays match across variants/repeats.

variants.old_fp8: Source-quantized X, Pull-quantized dY; build/fp8-source-final (previous turn).

implementation: Standalone source dY quantization on existing backward transport stream after producer dependencies, before the planner. Planner publishes packets using existing rank barrier. Pull copies FP8+FP32 scales; existing streamed dR column cache and BF16 dW unchanged.
limitations: Single-node N256 packed-ring path with streamed column caches. GIN/fallback remains unchanged and GIN is not runtime-tested here.
Symmetric input allocation remains BF16-sized to support BF16/FP8 calls sharing a runtime. Actual dY payload is 51.5625% of BF16 for measured H values.
BWD-only speedups do not establish full training-step speedups.
